'''Butch Malec''' won the [[1997 Coruscant Regionals (Pittsburgh)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I am a senior at General McLane High School in Edinboro. I am a member of the Drama Club, the Academic Competition Team, and Student Council. I play Warhammer 40,000 along with StarWars CCG. Favorite TV shows are ''Mystery Science Theater 3000'' and ''The Simpsons''. My favorite movie is ''Star Wars: A New Hope'', and my favorite band is They Might Be Giants. I plan on going to college next year to study Biology, Chemistry, and Theater. I am a singer in a local ska band named Skat In The Hat. I am good friends with fellow World Finalist Rick Sollman."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/malec.html Butch Malec], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428000309/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/malec.html Internet Archive]</ref>
